platforms.name: Groover Paid Curator Radio Label Playlist Submission Route
platforms.country: France / United States / worldwide music promotion platform
platforms.feeAmount: Paid credit route. Official page says artists pick curators/pros, upload a song or demo, and pay with Grooviz credits; contacting a curator/pro costs 2 Grooviz, with top-tier curators costing more.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for account/login, campaign creation, song/demo upload/link, curator targeting, genre fit, credit purchase, paid-routing terms and refund/feedback mechanics. No account was created, no credits were purchased and no track was submitted.
platforms.notes: Official Groover page exposes Sign up, Log in and Send my music routes, says artists can access 3,000+ curators/pros across playlists, press, radio, labels, bookers, managers and DJs, add a song or demo with a short pitch, receive guaranteed feedback within seven days or credit refund, and use paid Grooviz credits. Genres include pop, hip-hop/rap, electronic, R&B/soul, world/spiritual, reggae and more.

platforms.name: Playlist Push Spotify TikTok Campaign Curator Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / global playlist and TikTok music promotion
platforms.feeAmount: Paid campaign route. Official page says campaigns are flexible and Spotify campaigns typically start at $280.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for artist account/session, Spotify/TikTok campaign selection, campaign budget, target fit, track link/snippet, creative brief, curator/creator network terms, cookie-consent boundary and dashboard reporting. No account was created, no campaign was started and no payment was made.
platforms.notes: Official Playlist Push page exposes Create new Account, Sign in, Promote your Music and Submit your Track app routes. It describes Spotify playlist pitching to independent curators, TikTok creator campaigns, curator vetting, written feedback/placement decisions, live reporting dashboards and an Artist Protection Fund credit mechanism when a curator does not review before deadline.

platforms.name: DropTrack Artist Label DJ Radio Blog Promo Campaign Route
platforms.country: United States / global music promotion and promo-delivery platform
platforms.feeAmount: Free-first / freemium manual route. Official page exposes a free account / free analyzer route and paid Pro/pricing boundaries for artists and labels.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for account/signup, uploaded track handling, supplied-contact usage, email campaign permissions, playlist placement option, AI-generated press/bio/artwork materials, analytics, paid Pro/ad-budget boundaries and recipient consent/compliance. No account was created, no contacts were imported and no campaign or upload was started.
platforms.notes: Official DropTrack page says independent artists and labels can reach DJs, labels, playlist curators, blogs, radio and fans via targeted submissions, email campaigns, playlist placement options, AI-generated press materials and analytics. It exposes artist/label/influencer signup routes, cloud app boundaries, pricing links, free analyzer/account language, genre-based contact lists and unlimited-track/upload Pro features.

platforms.name: Inflyte Promo Delivery DJ Radio Airplay Monitoring Route
platforms.country: United Kingdom / global music promo delivery and airplay monitoring
platforms.feeAmount: Paid subscription / pay-as-you-go route. Official pricing shows monthly plans from £44 and pay-as-you-go promo packs from £33, plus Stripe/VAT payment boundaries.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for account/login, paid promo pack or subscription selection, audio/asset upload, contact import/targeting, DJ/media/radio delivery, pre-save setup, RADAR monitoring, anti-piracy/watermarking and Stripe/VAT payment terms. No account was created, no payment was made and no promo was delivered.
platforms.notes: Official Inflyte page describes a promo engine for labels, agencies and artists to deliver promos, monitor airplay, build pre-saves and run campaigns. It supports contact import/targeting, drag-and-drop assets and audio, email/mobile/Rekordbox/Dropbox/SMS/WhatsApp ProLinks delivery, RADAR radio/playlist/DJ-set monitoring, WAV/AIFF/MP3 handling, pricing tiers and pay-as-you-go promo packs.

platforms.name: Obscure Sound Independent Music SubmitHub Direct Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / global independent music blog and playlist coverage
platforms.feeAmount: Free-first direct email route with paid/third-party-prioritized boundaries. Official page prioritizes SubmitHub and MusoSoup over email and also advertises paid PR services starting at $530.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for choosing free direct email versus SubmitHub/MusoSoup/paid PR path, protected/non-plaintext email-link handling, subject-line compliance, streaming-link readiness, press photo rights, bio/release background and third-party payment/session boundaries. No email address was decoded, no message was sent and no third-party submission was opened.
platforms.notes: Official Obscure Sound submissions page says the site has covered independent music since 2006 and welcomes releases in indie rock, indie pop, dream pop, folk, electronic, alt-R&B, singer-songwriter, hip-hop, ambient and more. It routes submissions through SubmitHub, SubmitHub Marketplace, MusoSoup and direct email with the subject line 'Obscure Sound Submission'; the rendered email link is protected/non-plaintext, so it was not decoded or stored as a usable address.
